description_en: Queries the starting price information of hotels that match the specified check-in and check-out dates and other filter conditions. This operation is applicable to partners using the selling price model. It is not applicable to partners using the settlement price model
description_zh: 查询某酒店在入离时间内，符合其他附加条件的各酒店的起价信息。该接口适用于卖价模式合作商。不适用结算价模式合作商
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen hotel-search --city-code 330100 --shids 100000 --district-code 330000 --check-in-date 2023-02-22 --check-out-date 2023-02-22 --sort-code 0 --dir 1 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --key-words '万豪' --min-price 100.0 --max-price 1000.0 --is-protocol true --hotel-star 0 --adult-num 1 --brand-code 100 --location 120.010059,_30.284666 --distance 100 --super-man 0 --pay-over-type 1 --payment-type 0 --btrip-user-id 1000 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --poi example-string --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: HotelSearch

parameters.help_en: The city code. Obtained from the basic city data in the travel approval. Required for international hotels
parameters.help_zh: 城市code(从出差审批中的查询基础城市数据，国际酒店必填)
parameters.name: city_code

parameters.help_en: The list of hotel IDs. Maximum: 20
parameters.name: shids

parameters.help_en: The district code
parameters.name: district_code

parameters.help_en: The check-in date in the format of yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: check_in_date

parameters.help_en: The check-out date in the format of yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: check_out_date

parameters.help_en:
The sort method. Valid values:

- 0: default
- 1: lowest price first
- 2: highest price first
- 3: nearest distance first
- 4: highest rating first
parameters.name: sort_code

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. This filter is not available for international hotels. Valid values:

- 0: descending
- 1: ascending
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向(国际酒店无此筛选项)
parameters.name: dir

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keywords for keyword-based search
parameters.help_zh: 关键词（关键词搜索时用)
parameters.name: key_words

parameters.help_en: The minimum price. Unit: CNY
parameters.name: min_price

parameters.help_en: The maximum price. Unit: CNY
parameters.name: max_price

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only protocol hotels
parameters.name: is_protocol

parameters.help_en: The list of star ratings to filter by
parameters.name: hotel_star

parameters.help_en: The number of adults
parameters.name: adult_num

parameters.help_en: The list of brand codes to filter by
parameters.name: brand_code

parameters.help_en: The coordinates (AMAP). Longitude comes first, followed by latitude
parameters.help_zh: 经纬度（高德），经度在前维度在后
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en: The search distance range. Unit: meters
parameters.name: distance

parameters.help_en: The role. 0 indicates a regular user. 1 indicates a special applicant
parameters.help_zh: 角色0表示普通人，1表示特殊申请人
parameters.name: super_man

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether mixed payment is supported. 0: supported. 1: not supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持混合支付 0 支持 1不支持
parameters.name: pay_over_type

parameters.help_en: The payment method. 0: corporate payment. 1: personal payment
parameters.help_zh: 支付方式0:企业支付；1个人支付
parameters.name: payment_type
